title: Shaker / Refining
blurb: Steam’s early fantasy starts here: sift value from sand and refine wet sand toward gold before the factory gets complex.

title: Conveyors & Launchers
blurb: Horizontal belts and vertical launchers replace shovel labor. Automate the path you walk most before you dig a megabase.

title: Filters
blurb: Sorting is survival. Separate sand, slag, and ore before merges so one junk material cannot freeze the whole line.

title: Fluids & Pipes
blurb: Water and heat interact with pixel materials. Learn one clean pump/pipe path early — floods bury pretty belt work.

title: Drones & Deep Tech
blurb: Steam’s EA roadmap points to deeper buildings, resources, chains, quests, and technologies. Confirm unlock timing per patch.
